SNOWBALL SIEGE - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-snowballsiege.txt.

A turn-based snowball fight between snow forts. Your two polar bear cubs take
turns: shuffle a few steps, aim, hold A to charge the throw and let go. The
wind changes every turn and pushes the snowball; every splat carves the snow,
so forts crumble and hills get holes. A hit chills a critter (hearts); at zero
it is snowed under, and one knocked into the frozen pond is out too. Switch to
a big snowball or a bouncing ice cube with B. Win the match and the next one
starts against a sharper computer; lose one and the run is over. Medals at
300, 900, 1800 and 3000 points, and your best is kept.

Run SnowballSiege.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  walk (a tap turns round)  Left / Right               arrow keys
  aim                       Up / Down                  arrow keys
  charge, let go to throw   A (hold)                   X (hold)
  switch the throwable      B                          Z
  look along the field      L / R                      Q / E
  start                     A or Start                 X or Enter
  pause / resume            Select (or Start in a run) Backspace or Esc
  players 2-4 join          A on their pad, on the title (B leaves)
  back to the title         A (or Select) on the results
  touch / mouse             pull back from your critter like a slingshot
                            and let go; tap beside it to shuffle; the round
                            button switches the throwable; drag the field
                            to look along it; a tap starts

Two to four players take turns on one field (hot seat: each plays its side
with its own pad): bear cubs, penguins, foxes and hares. The last side
standing wins; the results rank everyone by survival, then by score.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: SnowballSiege.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best score is saved in snowballsiege.srm next to the exe.
